content: 2026 docs framework landscape: Starlight (Astro) has best built-in i18n (locale routing, UI translation system), MDX, zero-JS-by-default with React islands for live previews via @astrojs/react; Nextra/Fumadocs fit when docs live in Next.js; Docusaurus mature but heavier. Live editable previews commonly via react-live or Sandpack embedded in MDX. llms.txt is served as a static file from the docs app public dir, generated by a build step. Docs app consumes workspace packages via workspace:* and imports the CSS package directly.
